subs.math: 4,000 emails a month fit the 12,000-email Growth plan for 1,000 contacts.
20,000 emails a month fit the 60,000-email Growth plan for 5,000 contacts.
40,000 emails a month fit the 120,000-email Growth plan for 10,000 contacts.
200,000 emails a month fit the 600,000-email Growth plan for 50,000 contacts.

appmail.math: 3,000 emails a month fit inside the free API allowance of 35,000 a month, which needs approval first.
10,000 emails a month fit inside the free API allowance of 35,000 a month, which needs approval first.
50,000 emails a month. Emails above the 35,000 free API allowance cost $1 per 1,000, which comes to $15 a month.
The published 100,000-email API offer costs $50 a month.
